description: Goalkeeper invariant enforcement: blocks direct Edit/Write to an active goal's contract.md, log.md, state.json, to active.json/chain.json, and to the live mission's mission.json/mission-log.md/mission-completed.md — those files are managed exclusively by the gk CLI so the audit trail and contract immutability are guarantees, not requests. The user-authored mission.md charter is never blocked. Fails open: allows everything when no goal or mission is live, and on any parse error.
